semiconductor_relevance: Medium — TOKALO provides surface modification solutions that enhance the functionality of components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: TOKALO is a manufacturer specializing in surface modification solutions that improve the performance and longevity of components in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Their technologies include various coatings that provide insulation, corrosion resistance, and wear resistance, contributing to enhanced yield and quality in semiconductor production.
capabilities: Ceramic spraying for insulation and plasma resistance
Hydrophilic and corrosion-resistant coatings for small-diameter pipes
Slow-leak DLC coatings for static electricity dissipation
